speaker: voicedata-candidate-b
prosody_source: Voice B training-set mean of foundation-normalized prosody features

serving.selection_score: speaker_similarity - 1.0 * cer, optionally minus 0.05 * F0-envelope penalty

notes: Adds the long-form fix to recipe v3: the frozen duration head under-budgets frames for long text (measured 0.0635 seconds per character on 189-character prompts versus the 0.083 natural Candidate rate), which produced rushed, mumbled long sentences. Synthesis now splits text into clause-sized chunks of at most 120 characters at sentence and comma boundaries, renders each chunk independently with a 0.085 seconds-per-character frame floor, and joins chunks with a 160 ms pause. Long-form WER fell from 36.6 percent to 10.7 percent single-seed; each chunk is a short in-distribution generation. Chunked synthesis is incompatible with reference conditioning, which remains abandoned.
